title: job import grammar
description: Root document for `job import`. Parses the first fenced YAML block in a Markdown file whose top-level key is `tasks`.

tasks.description: Tasks form a tree. Work happens on leaves: a parent is a container, and it auto-closes when its last child closes — so if a parent has work of its own, model that work as a leaf child rather than putting it on the parent.

desc.description: Optional free-text description. Paragraphs separate with a blank line. Assume the reader is an agent with fresh context.

ref.description: Optional author-chosen handle, unique across the entire import. Used by blockedBy entries elsewhere in this document. Refs are not persisted on task rows.

blockedBy.description: Optional list. Each entry must resolve in order: (1) a ref defined elsewhere in this import; (2) a verbatim task title elsewhere in this import (must be unambiguous); (3) a pre-existing short ID in the database.

criteria.description: Optional list of acceptance-criterion labels. All criteria are created in the 'pending' state; transitions land later via 'job done --criterion label=passed' or 'job edit --set-criterion label=passed'.

children.description: Optional sub-tasks, recursive. Same grammar as the root task entries.
